confidence_notes: The Phnom Penh price index was updated 2026-10-16 and includes 570 entries from 38 contributors in the past year; restaurant, coffee, and beer anchors use those typical prices. Accommodation is a holistic estimate, while cocktail and wine prices are extrapolated as several times the local draft-beer price because standardized city observations are thin.
comparable_city_reasoning: No separate comparable city; food anchors use the direct Phnom Penh price index, with accommodation estimated holistically for a Southeast Asian capital.
